objective.description: Extract pricing rules into a standalone module.

expected.summary: Lead with "Behavior-preserving characterization tests" (high), then refactor in behavior-preserving steps. 2 test suggestions, 2 fix steps.

suggestions.title: Behavior-preserving characterization tests
suggestions.rationale: A refactor must not change behavior; characterization tests pin the current behavior before code moves.

draft.description: Given the current observable behavior of the refactored area, when the refactored code runs, then outputs match the pre-refactor baseline exactly.

suggestions.title: Existing contract checks stay green
suggestions.rationale: Consumers of the refactored surface must see no difference.

draft.description: Given the public surface of the refactored modules, when existing contract tests run, then all pass unchanged.

steps.title: Pin current behavior
steps.description: Add or verify characterization tests over the code to be moved before changing structure.

steps.title: Refactor in reviewable steps
steps.description: Restructure in small, individually green steps; never combine behavior changes with structure changes.

risks.description: Uncovered behavior in the refactored area can change silently; coverage gaps are the main refactor risk.

fixPolicy.rollback: Each refactor step is independently revertible; revert the latest step on any behavioral difference.

evidence.detail: Caller requested refactor: Extract pricing rules into a standalone module.
